scope: Compiler and runtime test cases for PineWASM.

cases.source:
//@version=6
indicator("dynamic arrow static defaults")
plotarrow(close,title="Dynamic null",colorup=bar_index==1 ? na : #336699,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close,title="Dynamic alpha",colorup=bar_index==1 ? color.new(#336699,70) : color.new(#336699,20),colordown=color.new(#993366,40))

//@version=6
indicator("arrow static role input-color-directions")
up=input.color(color.new(#336699,70),"Up")
down=input.color(color.new(#993366,40),"Down")
plotarrow(close,title="Input directions",colorup=up,colordown=down)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow static role input-bool-conditional")
choice=input.bool(true,"Choice")
plotarrow(close,title="Input choice",colorup=choice ? color.new(#336699,70) : color.new(#669933,20),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow static role input-new-color")
up=input.color(#336699,"Up")
plotarrow(close,title="Input transformed",colorup=color.new(up,70),colordown=color.new(#993366,40))

//@version=6
indicator("static role chart simple")
simple color UP=timeframe.isintraday ? color.new(#336699,70) : color.new(#993366,20)
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=color.new(#993366,40))

//@version=6
indicator("static role declared simple")
simple color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=color.new(#993366,40))

//@version=6
indicator("effective static series declaration")
series color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("effective static later write")
color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)
UP:=#669933

//@version=6
indicator("current before write")
color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("conditional before write")
color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
if bar_index%2==0
    UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("input after current call")
color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)
UP:=input.color(#669933,"Later")

//@version=6
indicator("constant condition before write")
color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
if true
    UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("fractional alias arrow alpha")
const float T=70.25
series color UP=color.new(#336699,T)
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=color.new(#993366,40.125))

//@version=6
indicator("fractional input arrow alpha")
UP=input.color(color.new(#336699,70.25),"Up")
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=color.new(#993366,40.125))

//@version=6
indicator("static alpha boundary")
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="T70.4",colorup=color.new(#336699,70.4),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="T70.5",colorup=color.new(#336699,70.5),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="T70.6",colorup=color.new(#336699,70.6),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="T70.9",colorup=color.new(#336699,70.9),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="T71.1",colorup=color.new(#336699,71.1),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="T72.4",colorup=color.new(#336699,72.4),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="T77.7",colorup=color.new(#336699,77.7),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="T50.2",colorup=color.new(#336699,50.2),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("static alpha constructor boundary")
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex-alpha76",colorup=#3366994c,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex-alpha75",colorup=#3366994b,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex-alpha74",colorup=#3366994a,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex-alpha77",colorup=#3366994d,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="rgb-fractional",colorup=color.rgb(51,102,153,70.9),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="new-constant-expression",colorup=color.new(#336699,70+0.9),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="new-expression-from-hex",colorup=color.new(#336699,color.t(#3366994b)),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="new-near-zero",colorup=color.new(#336699,0.9),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("numeric static transparency boundary")
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="new70.9>70.1",colorup=color.t(color.new(#336699,70.9))>70.1?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="new70.9>70.5",colorup=color.t(color.new(#336699,70.9))>70.5?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="new70.9>70.9",colorup=color.t(color.new(#336699,70.9))>70.9?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="rgb70.9>70.1",colorup=color.t(color.rgb(51,102,153,70.9))>70.1?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="rgb70.9>70.5",colorup=color.t(color.rgb(51,102,153,70.9))>70.5?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="rgb70.9>70.9",colorup=color.t(color.rgb(51,102,153,70.9))>70.9?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex75>70.1",colorup=color.t(#3366994b)>70.1?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex75>70.5",colorup=color.t(#3366994b)>70.5?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex75>70.9",colorup=color.t(#3366994b)>70.9?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex76>70.1",colorup=color.t(#3366994c)>70.1?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex76>70.5",colorup=color.t(#3366994c)>70.5?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex76>70.9",colorup=color.t(#3366994c)>70.9?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="new-from-hex75>70.1",colorup=color.t(color.new(#336699,color.t(#3366994b)))>70.1?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="new-from-hex75>70.5",colorup=color.t(color.new(#336699,color.t(#3366994b)))>70.5?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="new-from-hex75>70.9",colorup=color.t(color.new(#336699,color.t(#3366994b)))>70.9?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("exact static transparency rules")
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="new70.9-equals70",colorup=color.t(color.new(#336699,70.9))==70?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="rgb70.9-equals71",colorup=color.t(color.rgb(51,102,153,70.9))==71?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex75-equals71",colorup=color.t(#3366994b)==71?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex76-equals70",colorup=color.t(#3366994c)==70?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="rgb70.25-equals70",colorup=color.t(color.rgb(51,102,153,70.25))==70?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],title="hex01-equals100",colorup=color.t(#33669901)==100?#112233:#445566,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("constant gradient alias arrow")
color UP=color.from_gradient(0.5,0,1,#336699,#993366)
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("persistent cross bar gate")
var bool gate=false
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
if gate
    UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)
gate:=true

//@version=6
indicator("persistent invariant gate")
var bool gate=false
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
if gate
    UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("nonpersistent reset gate")
bool gate=false
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
if gate
    UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)
gate:=true

//@version=6
indicator("unconditional loop arrow write")
color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
for i=0 to 1
    UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("later iteration arrow write")
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
bool gate=false
for i=0 to 1
    if gate
        UP:=#669933
    gate:=true
plotarrow(close-close[1],colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow fractional static constructor boundary")
plotarrow(close,title="rgb-47.4",colorup=color.rgb(18,52,86,47.4),colordown=color.rgb(101,67,33,47.4))
plotarrow(close,title="rgb-47.5",colorup=color.rgb(18,52,86,47.5),colordown=color.rgb(101,67,33,47.5))
plotarrow(close,title="rgb-47.6",colorup=color.rgb(18,52,86,47.6),colordown=color.rgb(101,67,33,47.6))
plotarrow(close,title="rgb-70.9",colorup=color.rgb(18,52,86,70.9),colordown=color.rgb(101,67,33,70.9))
plotarrow(close,title="new-47.6",colorup=color.new(#123456,47.6),colordown=color.new(#654321,47.6))
plotarrow(close,title="hex-86",colorup=#12345686,colordown=#65432186)

//@version=6
indicator("colorer callsite alias pair")
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
color before=UP
UP:=#669933
color after=UP
plotarrow(close,title="Alias before",colorup=before,colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close,title="Alias after",colorup=after,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("colorer callsite loop pair")
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
plotarrow(close,title="Before loop",colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)
for i=0 to 1
    UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close,title="After loop",colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("colorer callsite helper pair")
identityColor(color c)=>c
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
plotarrow(close,title="Helper before",colorup=identityColor(UP),colordown=#993366)
UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close,title="Helper after",colorup=identityColor(UP),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("colorer callsite gate alias helper")
identityColor(color c)=>c
var bool gate=false
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
color selected=gate ? UP : #993366
plotarrow(close,title="Gate alias helper",colorup=identityColor(selected),colordown=#993366)
gate:=true

//@version=6
indicator("arrow helper qualifier typed one")
identityColor(color c)=>c
plotarrow(close,title="Typed constant",colorup=identityColor(#336699),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow helper qualifier typed two")
identityColor(color c)=>c
plotarrow(close,title="Typed constant one",colorup=identityColor(#336699),colordown=#993366)
plotarrow(close,title="Typed constant two",colorup=identityColor(#669933),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow helper qualifier untyped one")
identityColor(c)=>c
plotarrow(close,title="Untyped constant",colorup=identityColor(#336699),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow helper qualifier simple one")
identityColor(simple color c)=>c
plotarrow(close,title="Simple constant",colorup=identityColor(#336699),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow helper qualifier series one")
identityColor(series color c)=>c
plotarrow(close,title="Series constant",colorup=identityColor(#336699),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow helper qualifier untyped pair")
identityColor(c)=>c
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
plotarrow(close,title="Untyped before",colorup=identityColor(UP),colordown=#993366)
UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close,title="Untyped after",colorup=identityColor(UP),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow helper qualifier zero argument")
fixedColor()=>color.new(#336699,70)
plotarrow(close,title="Zero argument constant",colorup=fixedColor(),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow helper source literal before")
identityColor(color c)=>c
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
plotarrow(close,title="Literal helper before",colorup=identityColor(#123456),colordown=#993366)
UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close,title="Persistent helper after",colorup=identityColor(UP),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("arrow helper source snapshotted alias")
identityColor(color c)=>c
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
color before=UP
UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close,title="Helper snapshot alias",colorup=identityColor(before),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("persistent float operand")
var float T=70
plotarrow(close,title="Before",colorup=color.new(#336699,T),colordown=#993366)
T:=20
plotarrow(close,title="After",colorup=color.new(#336699,T),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("persistent float helper operand")
identityColor(color c)=>c
var float T=70
plotarrow(close,title="Before helper",colorup=identityColor(color.new(#336699,T)),colordown=#993366)
T:=20
plotarrow(close,title="After helper",colorup=identityColor(color.new(#336699,T)),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("same color conditional assignment")
color UP=#336699
if bar_index%2==0
    UP:=#336699
plotarrow(close,title="Same value conditional",colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("same color constant branch")
color UP=#336699
if true
    UP:=#336699
plotarrow(close,title="Same value literal branch",colorup=UP,colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("zero argument mutable persistent color")
var color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
currentColor()=>UP
plotarrow(close,title="Before helper",colorup=currentColor(),colordown=#993366)
UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close,title="After helper",colorup=currentColor(),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("zero argument mutable ordinary color")
color UP=color.new(#336699,70)
currentColor()=>UP
plotarrow(close,title="Before helper",colorup=currentColor(),colordown=#993366)
UP:=#669933
plotarrow(close,title="After helper",colorup=currentColor(),colordown=#993366)

//@version=6
indicator("zero argument mutable float operand")
var float T=70
currentColor()=>color.new(#336699,T)
plotarrow(close,title="Before helper",colorup=currentColor(),colordown=#993366)
T:=20
plotarrow(close,title="After helper",colorup=currentColor(),colordown=#993366)

plotarrow(close,title="Simple after",colorup=identityColor(UP),colordown=#993366)
